records.surface: Governor: 3 Advisory Board votes + 24h timelock; Registry upgrades every module
records.onchain_observed: Governor (0xcafea6063d4Ec6b045d9676e58897C1f0882Ca32, EIP-1967 proxy; implementation Governor 0xcafea466bF6dEFe480cdd54056C020c63b7DA830, Sourcify exact_match): TIMELOCK_PERIOD() = 86400s, VOTING_PERIOD() = 259200s, ADVISORY_BOARD_THRESHOLD() = 3. Registry (0xcafea2c575550512582090AA06d0a069E7236b9e, ADVISORY_BOARD_SEATS() = 5) lists the Governor at contract index 2, is the proxyOwner() of all 10 module proxies resolved through NXMaster.getLatestAddress (GV, P1, MR, TC, CO, SP, RA, AS, CI, LO), and is itself an EIP-1967 proxy administered by the Governor; its verified upgradeContract is onlyGovernor. Pause: getPauseConfig() = 0; isEmergencyAdmin() is true for 6 EOAs (the 5 Advisory Board seat holders and 0x6fe2c2643cb5064951fb7dd87fbce4777fb146e3), and a pause needs one admin to propose and another to confirm. Context, not compared: the legacy NXMaster (0x01BFd82675DBCc7762C84019cA518e701C0cD07e) is owned by the legacy Governance proxy (0x4A5C681dDC32acC6ccA51ac17e9d461e6be87900) running TemporaryGovernance, whose advisoryBoardMultisig (0x51ad1265C8702c9e96Ea61Fe4088C2e22eD4418e, 3-of-5 Safe owned by the 5 seat holders) can execute any call through it without a timelock; the docs list NXMaster and Governance as legacy.
records.documented_reference: docs.nexusmutual.io/governance/: 'Three votes in favour carry the proposal, at which point voting closes and the timelock starts.' and 'A 24-hour timelock runs before a carried proposal can be executed.'

PAUSE_GUARDIAN_ROLE has 3 members (2-of-6 Safe 0xB1345E7A4D35FB3E6bF22A32B3741Ae74E5Fba27, 0xff217004BdD3A6A592162380dc0E6BbF143291eB, 0xcC6451385685721778E7Bd80B54F8c92b484F601); UNPAUSE_ADMIN_ROLE: the 2-of-6 Safe. records.documented_reference: docs.euler.finance: '`FactoryGovernor` is installed as the `upgradeAdmin` of the EVK factory.' and 'The deployed EVC is immutable'; Euler forum: 'The signer set will be updated to 6 Euler Labs signers and 2 Foundation Directors, with a 4/8 threshold.' The prose docs state no delay; the official evk-periphery deployment script sets EVAULT_FACTORY_TIMELOCK_MIN_DELAY = 4 days.
